label: NativeScript (Vue 3)
deviceBuildGate: ns prepare ios --release && xcodebuild -project "$(ls -d platforms/ios/*.xcodeproj | head -1)" -scheme "$(basename "$(ls -d platforms/ios/*.xcodeproj | head -1)" .xcodeproj)" -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath "$TE_ARCHIVE" -derivedDataPath "$TE_DERIVED" archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=''
